# Pair Button and hosted-button tiles and name Toast and Popover for visitors

## Context

Ahead of the Mon 23 Nov `07:00 UTC` Engine 14 examples lock (`#21140`, `#21033`), two small front-door gaps remain across the split catalog (`apps/portal/resources/data/examples/*.json` at `origin/dev@40e63b1f94`):

1. **The two tiles held out of `neomjs/pages#174` / `#21940` for contrast repairs (`#21946`) have not yet rejoined `#21942`:**
   - `#21946` (`closedAt: 2026-11-22T14:50:45Z`) fixed Neo Light's black-on-black `.neo-button-badge` (`resources/css/theme-neo-light/button/Base.css`) and removed the hard-coded `theme: 'neo-theme-neo-light'` override in `examples/functional/hostComponent/Component.mjs`, specifying in AC-4: *"No cover in the pull request. Once it merges, the two tiles rejoin the `#21942` backfill."*
   - On `neomjs/pages@main` (`8fda4953bc`..`pages#194`), neither `devmode/tiles/button-base-14-light.jpg` nor `devmode/tiles/functional-hostComponent-14-light.jpg` exists yet, `functional-hostComponent-14.jpg` still predates `#21946`, and `button-base` + `functional-host-component` are the **only 2 published component tiles without `hasLightCover: true` out of all 59 published `kind: 'component'` records** (`node` scan over `apps/portal/resources/data/examples/*.json` at `origin/dev@40e63b1f94`, excluding `_`-prefixed files; positive controls: `button-split` and `functional-define-component` carry `hasLightCover: true`).
2. **Two `Dialogs & Overlays` cards still expose raw dotted class identifiers as visitor titles:**
   - Across all `166` catalog records in `apps/portal/resources/data/examples/*.json` at `origin/dev@40e63b1f94`, `toast` (`"name": "component.Toast"`) and `popover` (`"name": "plugin.Popover"`) in `dialogs.json` are the **only 2 published records** matching `/^[a-z][a-zA-Z0-9]*\.[A-Z]/` (positive control: `dialogs.json` siblings `dialog-drag-drop` → `"Contact Editor Dialogs"` and `tooltip` → `"Tooltips"`).

## The Problem

- Switching the Portal to Light mode leaves `Button` on `Buttons, Menus & Toolbars` and `Hosting a class component` on `Functional Components` on dark-stage tiles (`57/59` component tiles switch, `2/59` do not), while `functional-hostComponent-14.jpg` still shows the pre-`#21946` hard-coded button styling.
- Visiting `Dialogs & Overlays` shows `"Contact Editor Dialogs"` and `"Tooltips"` alongside internal namespace paths `"component.Toast"` and `"plugin.Popover"`, violating the `ROADMAP.md` v14 gate (*"finds each component family's examples as an overview in which every example names what it proves"*) and `#21333`'s no-class-name-title rule.

## The Architectural Reality

- Design authority: `ROADMAP.md` (*"every example names what it proves"*), `#21140` / `#21333` (visitor-facing titles over class names), and `#21946` AC-4 (*"Once it merges, the two tiles rejoin the `#21942` backfill"*).
- `buildScripts/docs/captureExamples.mjs` (`--tile examples/button/base` and `--tile examples/functional/hostComponent`) natively captures aligned `neo-theme-dark` and `neo-theme-neo-light` crops (`devmode/tiles/button-base-14{,-light}.jpg` and `devmode/tiles/functional-hostComponent-14{,-light}.jpg`) with 0 page errors.
- `Portal.model.Example` switches tile URLs to `-light` when `hasLightCover: true` (`apps/portal/view/examples/List.mjs#getBackgroundImageStyle`).
- `Prescription checked: apps/portal/resources/data/examples/{buttons,functional,dialogs}.json + neomjs/pages resources_pub/website/examples/devmode/tiles/ — owns the concern`.

## The Fix

1. Capture `examples/button/base` and `examples/functional/hostComponent` via `buildScripts/docs/captureExamples.mjs --tile ...` on `origin/dev@40e63b1f94` and open a companion `neomjs/pages` PR publishing `button-base-14.jpg`, `button-base-14-light.jpg`, `functional-hostComponent-14.jpg`, and `functional-hostComponent-14-light.jpg` (merging `neomjs/pages` before `neomjs/neo`).
2. Add `"hasLightCover": true` to `button-base` (`apps/portal/resources/data/examples/buttons.json`) and `functional-host-component` (`apps/portal/resources/data/examples/functional.json`), bringing published `kind: 'component'` tiles to `59/59` paired.
3. Rename `toast` from `"component.Toast"` to `"Toast Notifications"` and `popover` from `"plugin.Popover"` to `"Popover"` in `apps/portal/resources/data/examples/dialogs.json` (preserving `component: "Toast"` and `component: "Popover"`).
4. Add unit assertions in `test/playwright/unit/apps/portal/view/examples/MainContainerController.spec.mjs` pinning `hasLightCover: true` on `button-base` and `functional-host-component` and guarding published catalog `name` fields against raw `package.Class` strings (`/^[a-z][a-zA-Z0-9]*\.[A-Z]/`).

Decision Record impact: none.

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] `neomjs/pages` publishes `devmode/tiles/button-base-14{,-light}.jpg` and `devmode/tiles/functional-hostComponent-14{,-light}.jpg` captured from post-`#21946` `dev`, with readable badge and button labels in both dark and light crops.
- [ ] `button-base` (`buttons.json`) and `functional-host-component` (`functional.json`) carry `"hasLightCover": true`, and `toast` / `popover` (`dialogs.json`) carry visitor-facing `name` values `"Toast Notifications"` and `"Popover"`.
- [ ] `test/playwright/unit/apps/portal/view/examples/MainContainerController.spec.mjs` pins `hasLightCover: true` on `button-base` and `functional-host-component` and asserts zero published catalog records use raw `package.Class` `name` strings.
- [ ] Visual evidence on `Buttons, Menus & Toolbars`, `Functional Components`, and `Dialogs & Overlays` at `1440×900` and `390×844` (dark and light) passes with 0 console errors.

## Out of Scope

- Light-cover recipe captures for `toast` and `popover` (`manifest.recipes` entries remain single-pass in `captureExamples.mjs`; recipe pairing stays on `#21942`).
- Unmerged `Functional Components` tiles in `#21932` (blocked on `#21359` / PR `#22007`).
